title: Console: open the OTA admin and work a booking
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/sso-bookings.e2e.ts. The OTA API is reached only through the OTA admin's server (service key on loopback) or a secret key; there is no staff password on the OTA side.

steps.title: Own an OTA
steps.body: In the portal, sign up, verify, create an OTA (the OTA worker provisions `tenant_<key>`). The seeded demo OTA has no staff member.
steps.expect: Tenant active; your membership role `owner` in `platform.tenant_memberships`.

steps.title: Open console
steps.expect: `POST /v1/console/auth/sign-in` (portal token from `ptk:<sha256>`, single use, 60 s) → staff session; `staff_actions` row `staff.sign_in`; Redis `staffsess:<familyId>`. Posting the same hand-off form again → `401 PORTAL_TOKEN_INVALID`.

steps.title: Needs attention
steps.expect: `GET /v1/console/bookings` lists only the current environment (test) of this tenant; net amounts visible in console scope.

steps.title: Issue tickets
steps.body: A booking in `manual_review` (policy manual_review or the stub's `ticketing-failed` scenario): Issue tickets with a reason.
steps.expect: `POST …/issuance` → captures the authorised Stripe payment first, Flight Order Issue → booking `ticketed`; `staff_actions` `booking.issue` with redacted before/after; e-mail `booking.ticketed`.

steps.title: Cancel (void)
steps.expect: `POST …/cancellation` → DELETE voids the tickets; booking `cancelled` (`cancelled_by = staff`); refund mode none/full/amount; airline cards never refunded through Stripe.

steps.title: Note and resync
steps.body: Add an internal note; press Resync.
steps.expect: Note: `201`, a `booking_events` row `staff.note` (staff only unless `visibleToCustomer`), the text stored as typed in `summary` and `data` (no card-number check here, unlike the review-closure note); staff action `booking.note` with the note id only. Needs `bookings:write`: a finance user gets `403 FORBIDDEN`. Resync: Flight Order Management GET, segments/tickets updated, `429 RATE_LIMITED` within 10 s of the last refresh of the booking.

steps.title: Forbidden actions
steps.body: Sign in as a viewer and try Issue or open LIVE.
steps.expect: The admin hides the buttons; the API answers `403 FORBIDDEN` (`details.requiredPermission`) or `403 ENVIRONMENT_NOT_ALLOWED`, each with a `staff_actions` row `outcome = denied`.
